name: Entity Logger
description: Adds log messages to specific entities
project_description: Entity Logger records log messages against specific content or config entities, giving each entity its own activity log shown on a "Log" tab. It defines an internal content entity type (entity_log_entry) whose target_entity field is a dynamic_entity_reference, so a log entry can point at any entity type. Logging is done in code through the entity_logger service (log()) or the per-entity entity_logger.instance / entity_logger.instance.factory helpers (addLog, addInfoLog, addNoticeLog, addWarningLog, addErrorLog), and messages use PSR-3 placeholder style. Logging is only recorded for entity types that an administrator has enabled on the settings form (entity_logger.settings). A Views-backed embed display renders the per-entity log, a settings form controls the enabled entity types plus a retention period and cleanup batch size, and hook_cron deletes entries older than the retention period. It is intended for cases where the default Drupal watchdog is insufficient: log messages that live in the context of an individual entity, are persisted alongside content, and can be exposed to specific roles independently of the core log UI.
